text:
Christian Dvorak scored against his old team on Saturday, deflecting a Cam York point shot past Montreal, and it was a neat snapshot of what he gives Philadelphia: a veteran center who goes to the net and takes the hard minutes.

He plays nearly 18 minutes a night, and Evolving-Hockey ranked his competition in the 97th percentile last season. That load shows. The Flyers take only 41% of the expected goals at 5-on-5 with him on the ice, and they get outshot when he's out there. He has 15 points in 26 games, finishing right at his chances (5 goals on 4.69 expected), so there's no luck to cash in either way.

Lately he's been useful: 8 points in his last ten as Philadelphia won five of its last six. Our numbers see him landing around 50 points. The question for the Flyers is less about Dvorak than about whether anyone can take some of those top matchups off his plate.
